entries.title: Give commands keys that work only when you are not typing
entries.body: Record a plain letter in Keyboard settings to use it outside text fields. Your messages keep their letters. Plain keys and function keys without Command or Control can also answer or close a card, with a warning before saving. You can also choose when a modified key works. Escape leaves a message field when these keys are in use; your existing keys stay unchanged until you change them.
